head: dwq (< MEA dbq cf. SL 271: to stick to, adhere;)

senses.gloss: den Teig für das Fladenbrot an der Innenseite des Backofens festkleben, Fladenbrot backen;

stems.sensesRaw: den Teig für das Fladenbrot an der Innenseite des Backofens festkleben, Fladenbrot backen;

examples.turoyo: šawʕo=niše ko-layši, w šawʕo ko-ǧəġri at=tanure, w šawʕo ko-duqi
examples.translation: sieben Weiber kneten Teig, sieben heizen die Backöfen, sieben kleben die Brotfladen an
examples.raw: šawʕo=niše ko-layši, w šawʕo ko-ǧəġri at=tanure, w šawʕo ko-duqi ʻsieben Weiber kneten Teig, sieben heizen die Backöfen, sieben kleben die Brotfladen anʼ; 454; 73/258-259;

examples.turoyo: zəbṭina-lan bayto bas-yo fayšina b-u=tanur-awo k-oṯən an=noše hul d-ko-duqi kmo dawqe d-laḥmo haka nafəl gazguzo mede mḥalqi-li-yo xd-u=kalbo d-oxan-ne haw ko-maqbanno ono u=med-ano g-əzzi d-zobaṭn-i bayto
examples.translation: We shall rent ourselves a house. We shall no longer stay in that bakehouse (lit. ‘stove’). People come (there) to bake a couple of flatbreads. And if a piece (of a flatbread) falls down, they throw it to me like like I am some dog and should eat it. I shall no longer accept this! I shall go and get myself a house!
